payload.reason: The evidence provides specific features extracted from text, including named entities and various linguistic features used in Named Entity Recognition (NER) systems.

claims.text: Features extracted from text include named entities, part-of-speech tags, and local context tokens.
Text classification relies on techniques such as Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and bag-of-words.
NER systems utilize hand-crafted features and domain-specific knowledge, which are essential for performance.
